title: chore(qa): drop dead `src/**/*` include glob from dogfood tsconfig
body:
Fixes #10899

`packages/qa/dogfood` is test-only by design. Its `tsconfig.json` declared
`include: ["src/**/*", "test/**/*"]`, and the package has no `src/`. One glob
removed; nothing else in the file touched.

## The load-bearing measurement: the program tsc compiles is unchanged

`tsc --showConfig -p packages/qa/dogfood/tsconfig.json`, TypeScript 6.0.3 (the
version the package declares), run before and after the edit:

| reading | before | after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| resolved `files` entries | 151 | 151 |
| `files` identical, same order | — | `true` |
| entries only in before / only in after | — | `[]` / `[]` |
| `compilerOptions` identical | — | `true` |
| `exclude` identical | — | `true` |
| `include` as echoed | `["src/**/*","test/**/*"]` | `["test/**/*"]` |

`diff` over the two complete `--showConfig` outputs is exactly one line:

```
170d169
<         "src/**/*",
```

That single line is the echoed glob itself. Every one of the 151 resolved files
is under `./test/`; the dead glob contributed none of them. This is a removal of
a declaration, not a change to the compiled program.

## Ratchets: reverse-verified, readings do not move

The fix was committed first, then `git restore --source=` stood the base file
back up (tree only — porcelain showed a lone `M`, never `MM`), the two ratchets
that read tsconfig `include` sets were re-run, and the file was restored.

Both printed byte-identical verdict lines at base and at head:

```
check-type-check-coverage: OK — 65/78 workspace packages type-checked (plus the root),
  13 in the DEBT ledger (436 frozen raw errors), 1 exempt.
  test layer: 20 package(s) still hide their own tests from tsc (1048 files hidden ...)
  source layer: 9 directory(ies) ... (9 files as counted by this run).
  generated layer: 3 `include` entr(ies) across 1 package(s) ...

check-type-source-resolution OK — 77 packages with a tsconfig.json scanned;
  51 registered as still resolving a workspace dep's types through `dist/`.
```

The `generated layer` row is `apps/docs`, untouched by this diff. `dogfood`'s
`src` root was never in that population: that invariant's detector asks whether
an `include` root is **gitignored**, and `src` here is neither checked in nor
ignored — the distinction #10880 drew deliberately.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`
(no paths passed; it takes its own change set from the merge base), then treated
as a floor. All run at `99eee07a`, exit codes captured before any pipe:

| gate | exit |
|:---|:---|
| `check:empty-state` (spec) | 0 |
| `check:liveness` (spec) | 0 |
| `check:strictness-ledger` (spec) | 0 |
| `check:variant-docs` (spec) | 0 |
| `check:published-files` | 0 |
| `check:slot-lookup` | 0 |
| `check:test-source-alias` | 0 |
| `check:type-source-resolution` | 0 |
| `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` | 0 |
| `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs` | 0 |
| `check-affected-docs.mjs` | 0 |
| `check:type-check-coverage` | 0 (added above the derived list) |
| `check:nul-bytes` | 0 (added above the derived list) |

`check:type-check-coverage` is the floor extension that matters here: it reads
every package's `include` array, and the derivation did not name it.

## Declared narrowing: repo-wide `pnpm lint` not run

Measured rather than assumed, all three pieces:

1. **Population, read from eslint's own config, not from a guess.** `pnpm exec
   eslint --no-inline-config --format json packages/qa/dogfood/tsconfig.json`
   returns one result whose only message is `File ignored because no matching
   configuration was supplied.` The changed file is not in eslint's population.
2. **Count, read from `--format json`.** 1 result entry, 0 errors, 1 warning,
   and that warning is the not-configured notice above — 0 files in this diff
   are linted.
3. **Invariance for untouched files.** `eslint.config.mjs` states in-repo, with
   a positive control behind it, that this repo "never enables type-aware
   linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules) for
   ANY file, test or not." No tsconfig `include` change can move an eslint
   verdict on a file it does not appear in.

## Deliberately not done

- **No `src/` directory created.** The declaration was wrong, not the tree.
- **`rootDir: "../../.."` and its comment untouched.** That shape is load-bearing
  — the route-ledger to live-mount parity gate imports five sibling packages'
  ledgers as relative sources — and was reasoned about. Only the dead glob moved.
- **No changeset.** `@objectstack/dogfood` is `private: true` and this diff
  changes no published artifact; `skip-changeset` is applied.

## Files changed

`packages/qa/dogfood/tsconfig.json` — 1 insertion, 1 deletion.
